notes: *there ... be able to* stays with יִתְיַצֵּב: the dummy belongs to the verb's unit under rule 17's presentative sentence, and a modal the ASV writes as separate words is an auxiliary of the verb rather than rule 20's wholly supplied lexical verb, since a verb is written in the clause.
*no* is the negative's, recast onto the subject nominal under rule 15, leaving אִישׁ the bare *man*.
מִתַּחַת is split (*from under*) while בְּפָנֶיךָ is fused (*before*), each decided by the English written (rule 30).
